ideas.pitch: A predictive forecasting dashboard for San Francisco transit operators using Poisson regression and spatial clustering to anticipate micro-mobility gridlock.
ideas.title: San Francisco Urban Micro-Mobility Demand Shifter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact architectural blueprint of past 1st-place forecasting winners by combining statistical models (Poisson GAM) with clear 90% prediction intervals, appealing to judges looking for rigorous backend data science rather than generic wrappers.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous AI agent marketplace facilitating instant USDC escrow transactions for hyper-local Bay Area service micro-contracts on Base.
ideas.title: BayArea Local Merchant Escrow Market
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven autonomous marketplace and crypto-escrow pattern that secured 1st place at Synthesis, directly appealing to modern fintech and agentic workflow judges.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered no-code trading strategy builder and execution engine tailored for high-frequency perpetual decentralized exchanges.
ideas.title: Pacific-Edge Decentralized Order Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the grand-prize winning mechanics of ClashX by offering a fully functional visual strategy builder that non-technical judges can test live during the demo.

ideas.pitch: An AI nutrition and wellness assistant that parses local San Francisco restaurant menus to deliver hyper-personalized meal recommendations and nutritional insights.
ideas.title: NutriLocal SF Personal Health Synthesizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the exact formula of the Hour Hackathon winner by combining consumer-facing health utility with rapid API integrations, scoring high on user experience and polish.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and resource allocation platform utilizing LangGraph and local RAG to automate university sustainability reporting.
ideas.title: EcoCampus Multi-Agent Support Grid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs the multi-agent RAG architecture that won 1st place at GreenNovation, demonstrating complex state management and orchestration that technical judges favor.
